_doc: Source-trust map for the seo-bot research pipeline. Everything scraped is a CLAIM scored against this. Re-verify handles/affiliations periodically against owners' own sites (impersonators are common). Tier weights are deliberate; tune against the claims.json audit log over time.
_adversarial_note: ADVERSARIAL_SIGNAL (0.15) is BELOW watch (0.35): manipulation operators (Jacky Chou etc.) are tracked as intel about what's being sold, but their tactics can never cross auto(0.75)/human-review(0.55) — quarantined by design.
